summary: A young woman with a prosthetic arm confronts a young man on a bridge, who reluctantly admits he is freaked out.

dialogue.speaker: MAN
dialogue.text: All right, fine. I'm freaked out.

visuals.description: A young man and a young woman stand on a bridge, facing each other. The woman has a mechanical prosthetic arm extended towards the man. Both are leaning against the bridge railing with trees and buildings in the background.
notable_elements: WOMAN's black and blue athletic jacket
WOMAN's black leggings with pink stripe
